### How to customize a cutting board

Decorating your [kitchen and dining](https://www.etsy.com/c/home-and-living/kitchen-and-dining?ref=market_content&utm_campaign=market_content) areas with practical and aesthetically pleasing items, like custom wood cutting boards, is a great way to infuse a bit more of your personal style into your space. Add some flair to your kitchen with a custom cutting board created exactly to your specifications by the woodworkers on Etsy.

You’ll have a few decisions to make as you customize a cutting board. Here’s what you need to know:

- **Wood:** From cherry, mahogany, and walnut to light oak, maple, and bamboo, the first choice when selecting handmade cutting boards is the material. You can choose a wood that matches your kitchen to keep your style cohesive, or select the wood tone you like the most and let it be an accent in your room.
- **Size:** If you plan to display the cutting board in your kitchen and have the room, opt for a larger size so it stands out on the counter, leaning against your range, or hanging on the wall. The sellers on Etsy offer an assortment of sizes, including oversized, extra-thick, and extra-long options.
- **Handles:** A small shop on Etsy can easily design your cutting board with a built-in handle for convenient maneuvering or hanging it in your kitchen for decoration.
- **Personalization:** Personalize your cutting board with your last name, a monogram, a favorite quote, a special anniversary date, or a family recipe carved or burned into the surface to create a family heirloom.

### What cutting boards are best for knives?

Wood cutting boards, such as [custom walnut cutting boards](https://www.etsy.com/market/custom_wood_cutting_board?ref=market_content&utm_campaign=market_content) are generally better for knives. Woods like walnut are gentle on knives while offering a durable, hard surface for chopping, slicing, and dicing.

While a [custom glass cutting board](https://www.etsy.com/market/custom_glass_cutting_board?ref=market_content&utm_campaign=market_content) is a beautiful addition to any kitchen, the surface could weaken knives over time and is better suited for decorative or serving purposes.

### How often should you replace a cutting board?

Cutting boards can last for quite awhile if they’re properly cared for and may not need to be replaced very often. Often, the seller will provide you with specific care instructions based on the type of wood and the construction of your cutting board. However, if your [custom kitchen board](https://www.etsy.com/market/custom_kitchen_board?ref=market_content&utm_campaign=market_content) has become overly worn, is splitting or cracking, or has deep grooves, it’s a good idea to replace it.

## FAQs

Can I view a preview of my order?


Yes! Please let us know if you'd like to see a preview of your order, we'd be happy to send it to you via Etsy messages (unless you specify differently on the order comments).

PLEASE NOTE: If you do not respond or we do not hear back from you, your order will automatically enter production to adhere to Etsy policies.


How long does a custom order take?


Once submitted, your personalized order will be created within 3-5 business days and will take approximately an additional 2 - 10 business days to arrive by either FedEx, UPS or USPS Service. Next-Day, 2-Day and 3-Day expedited delivery options are available. Please contact us if you'd like to upgrade your shipping. Production/Ship time is estimated in Business Days. We also do our best to ship your entire order in one box and/or together.

NOTE: During the Holiday Season production and ship time vary, be sure to order in advance!

NOTE: Orders placed after 3 pm pst on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday go into production Monday morning.

RUSH ORDER: Please let us know in advance if you have a tight deadline and we will do our best to meet it.


Can I add my logo/artwork to an order?


Yes! Please see our selection of Your Logo products where you can Print or Emboss your own Logo or image. All "Your Logo" or custom image orders are considered custom orders. All custom orders are sent a complimentary virtual proof that MUST be approved via email before the order goes into production. Contact us for more details.

You can also create and submit a custom order by sending us a message. Simply find a design you like or you can create your own. We will provide you with a quote for your approval. Once approved, we will create a custom order that you'd be able to submit.


What kind of paper stock do you use? Is it high-quality?


All of our Personalized Stationery is produced on extremely high-quality papers and envelopes. Each product is unique and paper choices include Single, Double & Triple Thick stock as well as 100% Cotton Paper, where applicable. Each product page displays the paper stock and thickness as well as the personalization process used for your item.

Our flat cards will have the thickest and sturdiest feel since they are 140 lb. stock.

Our fold notes are next in line at 110 lb. stock. Slightly less-weight than our flat cards to ensure they fold properly.

Our 6.25" x 9" letter sheets are 100 lb. stock so they can still go through printers, if needed. One fold is all they need to be put in the envelope, which still requires just one stamp.


Can I order a gift with a gift message?


Yes! Many of our customers order gifts to be shipped directly with a gift message. The gift message is on the packing slip. Please write your message in the order notes. Note: Prices are NEVER shown on the packing slips.


Can I order additional quantities? Is there a price/bulk discount?


Yes! You can order additional sets at a discount! Many products offer this option. Additional sets must be identical to the first set ordered. Send us a message if greater quantities are needed, or if you want your Logo Embossed or Printed or have a large list.
